images.caption: Doorway to the Schola Moralis Philosophiae ("School of Moral Philosophy") in the Old Schools Quadrangle of the Bodleian Library, University of Oxford. One of six former lecture rooms on the ground level of the quadrangle. They were taken over by the Bodleian Library between 1789 and 1884. This doorway now serves as the staff entrance.
